name: ram-v1
description: RAM RMA validation. Kill test, cold March patterns, hot March patterns, concurrent CRC stress, randomized verify. EDAC counter monitoring throughout. Tests cell defects at ambient AND under thermal load.

phases.name: baseline
phases.notes: 15s idle baseline. EDAC counters snapshotted at run start.

phases.name: full-load
phases.notes: 5 min kill test. stressapptest CRC + full CPU/GPU thermal pressure. Gross defects and hard cell failures crash here.

phases.name: cold-pattern
phases.notes: 20 min March-pattern test at ambient temp. memtester runs stuck-address, walking-ones/zeros, checkerboard against 80% of RAM. CPU/GPU idle to keep the bus clean — any error here is a hard cell defect, not contention or thermal.

phases.name: hot-pattern
phases.notes: 20 min March-pattern test under full thermal load. Same systematic algorithms as cold-pattern but with CPU/GPU heating the board. Catches thermally marginal cells that pass cold but fail hot — refresh failures, timing margin erosion. Lower RAM% (70%) because CPU/GPU need headroom.

phases.name: contention
phases.notes: 20 min concurrent CRC stress. Multi-threaded copy + write-CRC verify under full system load. Finds marginal DIMMs that pass pattern tests but fail under bus contention and PCIe DMA traffic.

phases.name: random-verify
phases.notes: 10 min stress-ng VM with randomized write/read-back verification. Different pattern generation than memtester or stressapptest — catches faults the deterministic March algorithms might miss. --vm-populate forces upfront page allocation, --verify checks every read.

phases.name: cooldown
phases.notes: 5 min cooldown. EDAC delta snapshot — any CE = WARN (degrading DIMM), any UE = FAIL.
